audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 (Level 6) was given to Ziggs at 7/10 while the row's own content why says 'Level 6 flips to Yasuo', and the mirror flipped exactly that row on its side.
audit.why: audits/top/yasuo__ziggs.json sets the shape this page must invert: Ziggs at level 1 only, row 1 Skill, rows 2-6 Yasuo. The packet chart's Ziggs on row 4 is the outlier and it contradicts this page's own whys[4].
audit.corrected: Row 4 flipped to Yasuo in both layers with the rating dropped to 3/10, and phases[4].why rewritten to state why the stage is his.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] and whys[6] claim the lane 'swings back to you' at first item and that you 'stay ahead' at two, on rows both layers already label Yasuo.
audit.why: Last Breath falls to 50s and then 30s as it ranks, Wind Wall to 17s at rank 5, and Steel Tempest is a flat 4s that a crit item turns into real damage. Nothing about his item timings hands the lane back to an artillery mage who cannot fight through the wall.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and whys[6] rewritten around Wind Wall's 17s and Last Breath's 30s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeats that Wind Wall blocks 'your entire kit' and 'every projectile' but never states the one split that decides fights: it eats Bouncing Bomb AND Mega Inferno Bomb, while Satchel Charge is not a projectile.
audit.why: Riot flags both Bouncing Bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb as projectiles, and Wind Wall blocksProjectiles for 4 seconds on 25/23/21/19/17s. Spending a 120s ultimate into a 25s wall is the single most expensive mistake available in this lane, and the page never said so.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and spikes[3].text now state that Mega Inferno Bomb is blocked too, with the 25s and 4s numbers.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Last Breath (70s at rank 1, 1400 range) blinks to any knocked-up target — his tornado into R beats your 120s ultimate.

edits.before: First item swings back to you: item poke and waveclear shove him under tower.
edits.after: At his first crit item Wind Wall (17s at rank 5) covers every approach angle.

edits.before: Into 2+ items you stay ahead — out-range him and he never gets to open a fight.
edits.after: Two items and one flank Last Breath (30s at rank 3) ends you outright.

edits.before: Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Wind Wall (25s at rank 1) eats Bouncing Bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb alike — never spend a 120s R into it.

edits.before: That is Yasuo’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Wind Wall lasts 4s and blocks the whole bounce path.

edits.before: Teamfights hinge on his Wind Wall and flank Last Breath. Fight near your team, E chokes to deny his E-dash gaps, and save Satchel to self-peel when he jumps your backline. Out-range him and he can never open.
edits.after: Teamfights hinge on Wind Wall: it blocks Mega Inferno Bomb as readily as your Q, so never open a fight into it. Fight beside your team, E the chokes he dashes through, and save Satchel for the moment he flanks your backline.

notes: packet suspectName 'Drop Hexplosive Minefield' is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Ziggs' own E, correctly named. Not asserted anywhere: whether Wind Wall's terrain component interacts with Hexplosive Minefield's mines, or whether Satchel Charge's knockback can displace him out of Last Breath — neither is in Riot's text and the mirror left both open too.
